cases.question: How many expenses did I submit in each month of 2026? Show the month number (1-12) and the count.

    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM hr.expenses.submitted_at) AS month_number,
    COUNT(hr.expenses.expense_id) AS expense_count
FROM
    hr.expenses
WHERE
    hr.expenses.employee_email = 'rkhanna'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hr.expenses.submitted_at) = 2026
GROUP BY
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM hr.expenses.submitted_at)
ORDER BY
    month_number
FETCH FIRST 12 ROWS ONLY
cases.answer: In 2026, you submitted 1 expense in January, 1 in February, 2 in March, 1 in April, 1 in May, 2 in June, 1 in July, 1 in August, and 3 in October.
